main_body: A wooden frame with a stretched golden hide that has blue patterns, drawn face-on. It has a thin brown top beam, side posts and a lighter brown bottom beam, with two small feet.
top_band: none: at x=15 the column runs outline (row 0), a brown beam (row 1), then the golden hide (rows 2-16) with no step. Rows 2-4 are only the upper part of the hide face, which is a vertical surface.
evidence: The top beam is a 1px brown line (row 1) with no horizontal surface visible from above. The hide panel fills the frame and is a vertical face. The bottom beam (rows 17-18) is also a front-facing band, with no top face readable above it. There is no eave shadow and no inset panel. This matches the red front-elevation case in the guide, so it fails.

style.evidence: The gold hide has about 4 tones and the wood has 3-4, with blue accents on top. The dark edge pixels are tinted (only 9% neutral), so the outline is a dark brown or blue rather than black. There are no 5x5 flat fills (0%), and the hide carries dither, stitch and pattern dots. The median of 12 colours per tile is below the references (17-20), and 15 distinct colours is well under their 38-40. The piece is small and simple, but it holds up next to the references without looking sticker-like.
